tagline: A well-connected, modern Asian side hub — the main crossroads for the Üsküdar metro and a growing commercial and dining scene.

items.name: Altunizade Çay ve Kahve
items.description: Several good café options around the Altunizade metro station and the surrounding streets. Practical and reliable.

items.name: Altunizade Restoranları
items.description: A growing restaurant strip on the main commercial streets. Mix of Turkish and international cuisines at reasonable prices.

items.name: Bağlarbaşı Kültür Merkezi
items.description: A cultural centre with regular concerts, theatre performances, and exhibitions. Worth checking the programme.

tips: Altunizade is on the M5 metro line — excellent connections to Üsküdar, Kadıköy, and across the Marmaray.
Primarily a transit and residential hub. The surrounding area is more interesting than the centre itself.
Bağlarbaşı (just south) has a more developed café and restaurant scene.
Good base for Asian side living with excellent transport connections.
